content.comment_body: Firstly, thank you – your advice solved my issue! I have another question: If I connect multiple [product_name]-[product_name] communication modules, how many VPN connections can my station (for example, a laptop) accept at once? Is it possible to monitor all modules simultaneously, for instance using [product_name] advance? Essentially, what is the maximum number of VPN connections I can open concurrently?

Closed since the question was posted twice. The second thread with the topic of multiple VPN connections on one station for [product_name]-[product_name] communication module is published in the [product_name] - Communication conference. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user has managed to establish a VPN connection to a [company_name] communication module and is now asking about the maximum number of simultaneous VPN connections that a single station (e.g. laptop) can support. The intent is to monitor several remote devices at once using software, highlighting a use case with multiple [company_name] modules. There is no definitive answer provided in the thread, and a moderator closed the thread due to duplicate postings.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates connecting to and monitoring several [company_name] communication modules simultaneously via VPN from a single computer using monitoring software. They seek information about the technical limit for concurrent VPN connections and whether it is feasible to access and monitor data from all devices at the same time.
